description: Sound pressure level in 1/3-octave bands at specified observer
Single-number SPL integrated over frequency range of interest
notes: Derived from 1/3-octave bands (log-sum of band energies)

description: Level of the fundamental blade passing frequency tone
notes: Frequency derived from RPM × blade count; prominence assessed versus 1/3-octave background
Harmonic indices (n×BPF) to be documented in case file

description: Overall SPL at cabin observer locations
notes: Used for cabin comfort evaluation and comparison to internal targets

description: Time-integrated sound exposure level over an event
notes: SEL in dB re reference sound exposure E₀ = (20 µPa)²·1 s; used for event-type metrics (e.g. flyover)

description: Perceived-noise metric used for certification-style approach/flyover/lateral points (Annex 16 / CS-36 / Part 36)
notes: Primary regulatory metric at approach, lateral (sideline) and flyover points; limit is mass-dependent per ICAO Annex 16 Vol I Ch.3 and cumulative margins per Ch.4/Ch.14

description: RMS vibration level at structural mount interface
notes: Interface quantity from 004A structural mounts FEM into vibro-acoustic analysis; typically band-limited (e.g. 20–500 Hz)
